name: Albemarle

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Albemarle Corporation Full-Color Logo with Registered Trademark.svg)

description: Albemarle is first a lithium producer: it turns lithium from Chile's Atacama brine and Nevada, plus spodumene concentrate bought from its 49%-owned Greenbushes mine joint venture in Australia and its 50% Wodgina venture, into lithium carbonate, hydroxide and chloride for electric-vehicle batteries, grid storage and glass and grease. Energy Storage was 53% of 2025 sales and 62% of segment profit, and its results swing with lithium prices (Q2 2026 Energy Storage sales $1,277M versus $718M a year earlier). Specialties makes bromine (flame retardants, drilling fluids) and specialty lithium; Ketjen makes refinery catalysts and was largely sold on March 2, 2026, leaving a 49% stake and the small PCS business. It reported a $511M net loss in 2025 after impairments.

hq.note: FY2025 10-K cover: 4250 Congress Street, Charlotte; Wikipedia S&P 500 list agrees

employees.note: approximately, including consolidated joint ventures; 40% US/Americas, 33% Asia Pacific, 19% Europe, 8% Middle East/other; about 26% union or works council (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Energy Storage
businessLines.how: Sold by the tonne to battery-material and EV supply-chain customers under contracts increasingly priced off index lithium prices, so revenue and profit swing with the lithium price.
businessLines.description: Lithium carbonate, hydroxide and chloride for batteries (consumer electronics, EVs, grid storage, solar) and other uses; sourced from Chile brine, Silver Peak Nevada and spodumene from the Greenbushes and Wodgina joint ventures.

businessLines.name: Specialties
businessLines.how: Sold per tonne to electronics, building, auto and energy customers on supplier-qualification contracts; price, performance and contract terms win awards.
businessLines.description: Bromine-based products (fire safety compounds, oilfield completion fluids, etc.) and specialised lithium products (organolithium, lithium metal) with technical and recycling services.

businessLines.name: Ketjen
businessLines.how: Catalysts sold to refiners that wear out and are re-ordered, plus one-off technology licences; ongoing replacement demand.
businessLines.description: Refinery catalysts (clean fuels technologies, FCC catalysts and additives) and performance catalyst solutions (organometallics, curatives). Refining Solutions was sold on 2026-03-02 (Albemarle keeps 49% of the new holding company); PCS business stays.

brands.name: Windfield Holdings Pty. Ltd. (Talison Lithium; Greenbushes mine)
ChemCat Holdings, LP (Refining Solutions)
brands.share: 49% (common units junior to the other owner's preferred equity), from 2026-03-02
